title: Skipping the Goodbye Wave Is DANGEROUS 🐟
description:
You never skip waving goodbye to the big tank, even if nobody's watching. Our shift is three people in one long dark hall at the aquarium, and one whole side is glass. Rosa waves like she means it. Dev waves like it's a joke.

It's made up. The aquarium, the characters and the sound are all built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment WAVE if you would have waved goodbye.
old_title: In This Aquarium the Night Shift WAVES at the Big Tank
